description:
BenchOverflow
	


	
		
		Overview
	

BenchOverflow is a benchmark dataset for studying a failure mode of large language models (LLMs) in which plain-text prompts elicit excessive outputs, a phenomenon we term Overflow.
As defined in the accompanying paper:

Overflow is the production of excessive text in response to seemingly benign user requests whose intent is not explicitly adversarial.

Unlike jailbreaks or prompt injection, Overflow arises under ordinary interaction settings and… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/deepkeep-ai/benchoverflow.
reputation: Niche but growing safety benchmark focused on a specific LLM failure mode (excessive generation) and cited in research on model robustness and alignment.
